CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Guest header shows core quick links with correct guest behavior
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open NAP and MRP as guest user on desktop. Verify My Account routes to sign-in and service icons (bag, wishlist, search) are visible.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
My Account redirects to sign-in for guest users.
Bag icon is visible without authenticated counter state.
Wishlist icon is visible without authenticated alert state.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Logged-in header routes correctly and shows account-specific states
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Log in on NAP and MRP. Verify My Account route, wishlist alerts behavior, and bag counter behavior in both empty and non-empty bag states.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
My Account links to account area for logged-in users.
Bag counter state updates correctly when cart has items.
Wishlist alert state is shown only when applicable.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Brand header identity and border styling match expected design
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Compare NAP and MRP header top area against approved UX reference for logo/brand treatment and border styling on desktop and mWeb.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Correct brand identity is shown for each site.
Header border is visually correct and consistent with design references.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Header icons render correctly per brand without cross-brand leakage
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Inspect header icons on NAP and MRP in desktop and mobile views. Confirm icon style/assets belong to the active brand and load without broken states.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
All required header icons render without missing or broken glyphs.
NAP and MRP show the correct brand-specific icon assets.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Search entry point and meganav host placeholder are present
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: On NAP and MRP, verify search icon/entry point is available and the header area reserves space for meganav hosting behavior.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Search entry point is visible and actionable.
Meganav host area is present without layout breakage.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Header works across desktop and mobile web including hamburger menu
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Test NAP and MRP on desktop and mobile breakpoints. Validate hamburger behavior on mobile and core header action availability at each breakpoint.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Core header actions remain accessible on all tested breakpoints.
Mobile hamburger navigation appears and functions as expected.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: PDP desktop no longer shows sticky header on up-scroll
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open a PDP on desktop and scroll down then up. Confirm the sticky header does not reappear and obscure product content.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Header does not become sticky on PDP up-scroll for desktop.
PDP content remains unobstructed during scroll interactions.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Header animation is stable during logout/login transitions
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Perform login and logout flows on NAP/MRP and observe header brand/name animation behavior during transition moments.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
No header flicker or broken animation appears during auth transitions.
Logo/name animation remains smooth and readable.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Customer name is not clipped in mobile header animation
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: On iOS Safari mobile (or simulator), log in and observe header animation where customer name appears.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Customer name text remains fully visible during animation.
No vertical clipping is visible in the header greeting area.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Customer name is not clipped on Windows desktop browsers
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: On Windows Chrome, log in to NAP/MRP and observe the rolling customer name in header.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Customer name is fully visible in header greeting area.
No clipping occurs at top or bottom of text line.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Scroll hide/show requirement wording overlaps with separate PDP sticky-header removal story
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Verify header behavior matrix by page type (homepage/category/PDP) and device breakpoint with product and design stakeholders.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: Behavior is consistent with latest agreed design and no unexpected sticky behavior remains on PDP desktop.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: G2-17898 AC includes generic hide/show statement; G2-20997 scopes PDP desktop removal.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Brand asset leakage risk across NAP/MRP builds
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Run visual spot checks on critical icon set after deployment for both NAP and MRP, including guest and logged-in states.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: No MRP-only assets appear on NAP and vice versa.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: Bug ticket explicitly states MRP SVGs were included in NAP build prior to fix.

EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Summary: Header name clipping defects are platform-specific (iOS Safari and Windows Chrome)
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.How to Validate: Execute focused browser/device matrix for customer-name animation after login/logout across iOS Safari and Windows Chrome.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Expected Observation: No clipping or baseline alignment defects appear in either environment.
EXPLORATORY_ROWS.Evidence Notes: Both bug tickets include reproduction steps and screenshots tied to specific platforms.
